title: Magic idk21 tools
description: Arcane Idk introduces a unique collection of mystical artifacts and utility-based magic to redefine your survival experience. This is only the beginning—expect many more reality-bending items in future updates!
body:
🌌 Gravity & Movement
Gravity Staff (NEW!): Hold Shift to fly upwards. Grants slow falling and fall damage immunity. (145 Durability).

Cloud Walker: Boots that create temporary platforms in the air as you walk.

Magic Boots (MISSING BEFORE!): Special enchanted boots that grant a permanent speed boost and increased jump height.

Echo Staff (REWORKED!): Creates a ripple effect in the ground, launching everything into the air.

Pocket Wormhole: A portable rift for instant short-distance teleportation.

⚔️ Combat & Destruction
Magic Wand: Long-range energy beam weapon (Compatible with Power & Piercing).

Life Stealer: A blade that heals you by damaging others.

Stone Turner: Petrifies enemies into statues (Slowness X + Blindness).

Fire Circle: A defensive ring of fire that burns nearby mobs.

TNT Duplicator: Duplicates ignited TNT for massive chain reactions.

🛡️ Defense & Utility
Time Weaver’s Pocket: A 10-second "rewind" to restore your previous position and health.

Time Stop Watch: Freezes nearby entities in time for a brief moment.

Thorny Rose: Blocks the next hit and damages the attacker.

Magnetic Mitt (FIXED!): Pulls nearby items to your hand (8-block radius).

Life Sensor: Allows you to see entity outlines through walls.

Gravity Grabber: Allows you to "pick up" and move mobs from a distance.

Gravity Well: A placeable point of gravity that sucks in all nearby life forms.
